capabilities: Toggle dense paragraph, heading and list spacing in reading view
Set line width from five presets or a custom 36-96rem slider
Pin a per-note line width from the command palette
Clear pinned widths from the settings page
extras: Purely display-layer: no files are modified. Settings, commands and notices are localized in English and Simplified Chinese; no network access or telemetry.
motivation: The author converted their own Style Settings-driven CSS snippet into a plugin specifically so users no longer need cssclasses frontmatter in their notes.
problem: Obsidian's reading view is spaced for skimming rather than reading, and adjusting line width per note requires hand-written cssclasses frontmatter or CSS snippets.

relations.evidence: This plugin started life as a CSS snippet driven by Style Settings.
Beta builds: add yunmin311/dense-reading-obsidian to BRAT.

summary: Reading-view typography plugin that tightens paragraph and heading spacing and applies switchable line-width presets, globally or pinned per note.
